test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 24 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: P and Q together can complete a work in 24 days. They started the work together but after 8 days P left the work. Remaining work is completed by Q in 20 more days. P alone can complete this entire work in how many days?
solution:
**

P + Q = 24 days

Worked together = 8 days

Remaining work done by Q = 20 days

Formula used:**

Work = LCM of days

Efficiency = Work ÷ Time

**Calculations:**

LCM of 24 and 20 = 120

⇒ Total work = 120 units

⇒ (P + Q) 1 day work = 120 ÷ 24 = 5 units

⇒ Work done in 8 days = 5 × 8 = 40 units

⇒ Remaining work = 120 − 40 = 80 units

⇒ Q completes 80 units in 20 days

⇒ Q’s 1 day work = 80 ÷ 20 = 4 units

⇒ (P + Q) = 5 units

⇒ P = 5 − 4 = 1 unit/day

⇒ Time taken by P alone = 120 ÷ 1 = 120 days

**∴ P alone can complete the work in 120 days**
